# Date: 2020-10-24 08:06:07
# Author: Adscn (adscn@qq.com)

import sys
import math

def chkmax(x, y):
    if x < y:
        x = y
        return True
    return False

def chkmin(x, y):
    if x > y:
        x = y
        return True
    return False

def geti():
    ch = sys.stdin.read(1)
    while not ch.isdigit() and ch != '-':
        ch = sys.stdin.read(1)
    f = False
    if ch == '-':
        f = True
        ch = sys.stdin.read(1)
    xi = 0
    while ch.isdigit():
        xi = xi * 10 + int(ch)
        ch = sys.stdin.read(1)
    return -xi if f else xi

def pi(k, ch=0):
    if k < 0:
        print('-', end='')
        k = -k
    print(k, end='')
    if ch:
        print(ch, end='')

N = 300010
P = 0
f = [[0] * N for _ in range(19)]
ifac = [0] * N
fac = [0] * N
inv = [0] * N

def fpow(a, b, c=1):
    res = c
    while b:
        if b & 1:
            res = res * a % P
        a = a * a % P
        b >>= 1
    return res

def init(n):
    fac[0] = 1
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        fac[i] = fac[i - 1] * i % P
    ifac[n] = fpow(fac[n], P - 2)
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        ifac[i] = ifac[i + 1] * (i + 1) % P
    inv[1] = 1
    for i in range(2, n + 1):
        inv[i] = (P - P // i) * inv[P % i] % P

def add(x, y):
    x += y
    if x >= P:
        x -= P
    return x

def sub(x, y):
    x -= y
    if x < 0:
        x += P
    return x

def FMT(f, n):
    l = 1
    while l < n:
        for i in range(0, n, l << 1):
            for j in range(l):
                f[i + j + l] = add(f[i + j + l], f[i + j])
        l <<= 1

def IFMT(f, n):
    l = 1
    while l < n:
        for i in range(0, n, l << 1):
            for j in range(l):
                f[i + j + l] = sub(f[i + j + l], f[i + j])
        l <<= 1

n = geti()
k = geti()
P = geti()

ans = fpow(k, n)

def pop(x):
    return bin(x).count('1')

lp = [0] * N

def ln(f, g, n):
    g[0] = 0
    for i in range(1, n):
        g[i] = 0
        for j in range(1, i):
            g[i] = (g[i] + f[i - j] * g[j] % P * j) % P
        g[i] = (f[i] + g[i] * (P - inv[i])) % P

def exp(f, g, n):
    g[0] = 1
    for i in range(1, n):
        g[i] = 0
        for j in range(1, i + 1):
            g[i] = (g[i] + g[i - j] * f[j] % P * j) % P
        g[i] = (g[i] * inv[i]) % P

if __name__ == "__main__":
    # No file I/O as per instruction
    if not sys.flags.interactive:
        pass

    if ~n & 1:
        m = int(math.log2(n)) + 1
        init(1 << m)
        for i in range(1 << m):
            f[pop(i)][i] = ifac[i]
        for i in range(m + 1):
            FMT(f[i], 1 << m)
        F = [0] * 20
        G = [0] * 20
        for i in range(1 << m):
            for j in range(m + 1):
                F[j] = f[j][i]
            ln(F, G, m + 1)
            for j in range(m + 1):
                G[j] = G[j] * k % P
            exp(G, F, m + 1)
            for j in range(m + 1):
                f[j][i] = F[j]
        IFMT(f[pop(n)], 1 << m)
        ans = (P + ans - f[pop(n)][n] * fac[n] % P) % P
    pi(ans)
